Dictionary_Elements.Item_Description: NCCR Persisent Identifier for the Data Platform

The ICD-9 or ICD-10 diagnostic code associated with the claim.

ICD-9 (International Classification of Diseases, 9th Edition): A system used to classify diseases and medical conditions for billing and statistical purposes. Example: 410.01

ICD-10 (International Classification of Diseases, 10th Edition): An updated version of ICD-9 with expanded codes and specificity, adopted by most countries. Example: E11.9

Claims are deduplicated over the patient ID, claim service date and claim procedure code. Each diagnosis code for a given claim will have a separate record.

Sequence number for diagnoses codes that occurred on multiple claims within the same month.

Claims are deduplicated over the patient ID, claim service date and claim diagnosis code. Records with the same diagnosis code occuring on different dates but in the same month will be assigned a different sequence number.
